payload.reason: The evidence provides specific examples of state-of-the-art baselines in the context of text-to-SQL models, including adaptations and performance metrics of various models.

claims.text: State-of-the-art baselines include models like CD-Seq2Seq and SyntaxSQL-con, which are adapted for context-dependent SQL generation.
Recent results show that models using intermediate representations, such as those by guo2019towards, achieve state-of-the-art performance in bridging natural language and SQL queries.
The performance of models can be significantly improved by using BERT embeddings, achieving results comparable to state-of-the-art models like IRNet.
